messages:
Alex: Hey team — PR #12456 is blocked by CI. linux-integ-3 failed with a session timeout ~1.5s into the run. I tried a rerun, still fails. Anyone seen this pattern lately? Need a decision on whether to hold merge.
ci-bot: [CI] build failed: linux-integ-3 (job 6789012)
ci-bot: failing test: tests/integration/test_session_recovery.py::test_session_timeout
ci-bot: trace snippet: ```
E   TimeoutError: session expired after 30s
  File "tests/integration/test_session_recovery.py", line 87, in test_session_timeout
    assert elapsed < 25
```
Maria: I saw that same test flake on a couple of PRs earlier this week. I noted it in #eng-infra but didn't spin up a ticket. Could be related to the KV proxy rollout causing reconnects.
Sam: Can you paste the full failing log (stdout/stderr)? The proxy often logs a reconnect before these timeouts.
Alex: Full tail from the job log:
```
2026-03-15T13:07:02Z INFO starting session id=abc123
2026-03-15T13:07:27Z WARN proxy reconnect, reason=EHOSTUNREACH
2026-03-15T13:07:33Z ERROR session handler timed out
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/tests/session.py", line 210, in wait_for_completion
    yield from asyncio.wait_for(task, timeout=25)
asyncio.exceptions.TimeoutError
```
Jordan: That reconnect at 13:07:27 looks suspicious. I've hit similar behavior when the proxy sidecar on the node is overloaded. We can try to repro locally with a smaller cluster.
Sophie: If this is infra noise we shouldn't block a refactor unrelated to sessions. Options: (1) single rerun and merge if green, (2) mark test flaky in flaky-tests.yml and follow up with infra, or (3) add a small retry in the harness to dampen spurious failures. Where does this PR touch? Is it safe to merge without the test passing this one time?
Alex: PR is an encoder batching refactor, nothing touching session code. I want the perf fix in main sooner rather than later, so I'm leaning to rerun once and merge on green. If it flakes repeatedly, we'll open an infra ticket and either mark the test flaky or add a transient harness retry.
Sam: +1 for one rerun. If it fails again, open the ticket and mark as flaky.
Maria: I'll take the code review. Please rebase on main (there was a small infra tweak) and push. Also add a short note in the PR description referencing the flaky CI and that you'll follow up if it repros.
Alex: Rebased and pushed (commit timestamp 1995012400), kicked a rerun: `/rerun ci 6789012`
ci-bot: [CI] rerun started: job 6789012 (attempt 2)
ci-bot: [CI] build passed: linux-integ-3 (job 6789012) :white_check_mark:
Alex: Great — thanks @Maria and @Sam. @Sophie can you give a quick approve when you have a moment? I'll wait for another approval then merge.
Sophie: Quick skim — looks fine, left one tiny nit inline. I'll approve after you squash that.
Alex: Squashed and pushed; also updated the PR description: "Observed intermittent session timeout in linux-integ-3; rerun cleared it. Will open infra ticket if it recurs."
Maria: Reviewing final diffs now. If everything is green I'll approve. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: [CI] all checks passed for PR #12456
Maria: Approved. +1 from me. Merge when ready.
Alex: Merged to main at 1995012445. Thanks everyone. I'll file an infra ticket with job id 6789012 if we see another occurrence.
Sam: Thanks — please include the job id and the node id (if available) in the ticket so infra can correlate.
Alex: Will do. :pray:
